finalists.label: Streptococcal endophthalmitis
finalists.why: Aerobic culture revealed Streptococcus intermedius and gram-positive cocci in chains were found on Gram stain.

finalists.label: Uveitis
finalists.why: Conjunctival hyperemia, faint keratic precipitates, and 3+ cells with fibrin in the anterior chamber were noted, which are characteristic of uveitis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of Streptococcus intermedius on aerobic culture and gram-positive cocci on Gram stain specifically support Streptococcal endophthalmitis over the more general diagnosis of Uveitis.
